batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan of the JU A Unit 2012-2013 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-a-2012-2013-set1.pdf (6 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: A ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১২-২০১৩, মোট নম্বরঃ ৬০, সময়ঃ ১ ঘণ্টা, boxed 'SET CODE: 1/2' — the paper is a MERGED PAIR paper for set codes 1 and 2, so the Drive listing label 'Set-1' is incomplete (see discrepancy). 60 questions: Bangla 3 (Q1-3), English 3 (Q4-6), Higher Mathematics 17 (Q7-23), ICT 1 (Q24, by content), Chemistry 18 (Q25-42), Physics 18 (Q43-60). Printed subject headings appear only for Chemistry ('রসায়ন', before Q25) and Physics ('পদার্থ', before Q43); all other subjects are assigned per question by content. Key form: the compilation prints a boxed 'Ans: X' (Latin letter) beside most questions and a 'Solve:'/'ব্যাখ্যা :' worked-solution box for numerical questions, the Ans box sometimes sitting inside the solution box. 47 questions keyed, 0 dual, 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions, 13 keyless (no box printed: Q1, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q11, Q17, Q44, Q46, Q47, Q60; empty 'Ans:' boxes with no letter: Q53, Q55, Q58). Three box-vs-solution conflicts (Q9, Q33, Q51): the printed box key is recorded and the conflicting solution value is documented in the question notes (the batch convention for these solved-paper scans, matching the sibling Wave-6 packs). Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 22 of 60 questions verified. row 1: key taken from Satt (a) row 3: excluded (DIFFER) row 4: excluded (DIFFER) row 5: key taken from Satt (b) row 6: key taken from Satt (b) row 7: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 8: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 9: excluded (DIFFER) row 11: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 12: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 14: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 15: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 17: key taken from Satt (c) row 20: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 21: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 22: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 23: key conflict - Satt key (c) recorded, answer unverified row 25: excluded (DIFFER) row 26: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 28: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 29: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 30: excluded (DIFFER) row 31: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 32: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 33: excluded (DIFFER) row 34: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 40: excluded (DIFFER) row 41: excluded (DIFFER) row 42: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (DIFFER) row 44: key taken from Satt (c) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 47: excluded (DIFFER) row 48: excluded (DIFFER) row 50: excluded (DIFFER) row 51: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 52: excluded (DIFFER) row 53: excluded (DIFFER) row 54: excluded (DIFFER) row 55: excluded (DIFFER) row 58: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 59: excluded (DIFFER) row 60: key taken from Satt (d)

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit Admission Test 2012-2013 — printed SET CODE: 1/2 (merged pair paper) (AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan; Drive listing 'Set-1')
sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (boxed 'Ans: X' Latin-letter keys; 'Solve:'/'ব্যাখ্যা :' worked solutions for numerical questions). Red aggregator banners 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com' / 'Get All University Admission Update...' and a diagonal 'ADMISSION WAR' watermark are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; the watermark covers several key boxes on pp.1-2 and p.6, which were read from min-channel (per-pixel minimum RGB) crops that suppress the coloured watermark. Two-column layout. Downstream cross-check partner (not used here): Satt Academy's JU A 2012-13 year-bank aggregate.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): A ইউনিট; গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ; জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১২-২০১৩; মোট নম্বরঃ ৬০; সময়ঃ ১ ঘণ্টা; boxed 'SET CODE: 1/2'. Printed নির্দেশাবলী: (১) প্রশ্নপত্রে ৬০টি প্রশ্ন আছে। সকল প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে হবে। (২) প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। (৩) নিচের 'ক' ও 'খ' বাক্য দুটি OMR উত্তরপত্রের নিচে 'ক' এবং 'খ' চিহ্নিত স্থানে লিখতে হবে। (৪) পরীক্ষা শেষে উত্তরপত্র (OMR) এর সাথে প্রশ্নপত্রও কর্তব্যরত সম্মানিত শিক্ষকের নিকট জমা দিতে হবে। (ক) ইচ্ছা থাকলে উপায় হয় (খ) Where there's a will there's way. A handwritten circled '১৮' on the header is a reader mark, not print.
